mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, o.address_snapshot AS addressSnapshot, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status, o.paid_at AS paidAt, o.shipped_at AS shippedAt, o.created_at AS createdAt, COUNT(oi.id) AS itemCount FROM `order` o INNER JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id AND p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} WHERE o.id IN #{oid} GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT oi.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, LEFT(p.images, 200) AS productImages, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.subtotal FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id AND p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} AND p.merchant_id != #{merchantId}
